origins.real: observed-derived; impact only, no latent truth
origins.synthetic: analytic signal plus controlled perturbations, observed coordinate/mask patterns

normalization: error divided by channel amplitude scale in channel_scales.csv; synthetic arrays computed in normalized units; units-RMSE multiplies by scale
independence: 60 paired participant patterns; sessions, breaths, scenarios and replicates not independent patients
missing_values: NaN; never zero-fill; abstentions reported through coverage

metric_definitions.native_rmse: RMSE vs analytic truth at original positions with finite output
metric_definitions.grid_rmse: RMSE vs analytic function evaluated at target grid centers, not a smoothed/bin-averaged truth
metric_definitions.score: .25*native_rmse+.75*grid_rmse, balanced by scenario family then phase/channel within participant
metric_definitions.peak_height_ratio: estimated signed local feature height divided by imposed amplitude; not clinical VO2peak
metric_definitions.peak_time_error_s: absolute error in equivalent-phase time, not physical time through workload plateaus
metric_definitions.width_error_s: sampled connected width above half true feature amplitude; no crossing interpolation; proxy seconds
metric_definitions.feature_area_error_norm: absolute integrated residual-minus-true-feature over common observed local positions, divided by amplitude*nominal FWHM
metric_definitions.adequately_sampled: at least 3 finite local points and at least 2 within true FWHM; insufficiently sampled cases are retained
